t: The Paragon Pathway specialises in knowledge of the natural world and crafting items. They have excellent scientific knowledge, historical knowledge, mechanical knowledge, can create powerful Beyonder weapons, and have an intuitive knowledge of using and avoiding the drawbacks of sealed items.

The Paragon Pathway primarily focuses on mastering scientific knowledge, enhancing memory, intelligence, and logical reasoning abilities. Unlike the Hermit Pathway and many other Pathways, it doesn't involve high spirituality, seeing things that shouldn't be seen, or hearing voices that shouldn't be heard. It also doesn't attract disasters, making it relatively safe for daily life.

At High-Sequences, they can pour their spirit into objects they create to give them life, destroy the structures of most objects, extract environmental information, turn into fog, alter the laws of physics, see the essence of things, and promote the light of civilisation known as technology.
The Above the Sequence of the Paragon Pathway is the Demon of Knowledge, and the corresponding Sefirah is the Knowledge Moor.
